propositions: _metric_invoke invokes scc without --by-file flag, causing scc to return language summaries with empty Files arrays instead of per-file entries
_scc_files depends on populated Files array from scc JSON output but receives empty arrays, preventing the threshold loop from executing and metric matches from being emitted

rebar.builtin.smell.metric-oversize detector contract promises file matches for files over 800 LOC threshold, but current backend implementation can never emit such matches due to missing scc argument

scc 3.7.0 documented behavior requires --by-file flag to populate per-file JSON entries; the same defect was previously fixed in code-health adapter (rapid-cuboid-velvetcrab), identifying grounding backend _scc_files as a separate unfixed consumer of scc JSON
adding --by-file to _metric_invoke restores metric detection without changing threshold values, Code field semantics, or fail-open error handling behavior
